LoomLens AI 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Instantly estimates USD cost for any prompt across 19+ AI models before running.
- Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, xAI, MiniMax, and local models.
- Displays token breakdown (input/output/cached) and cost per complexity level.
- Identifies cheapest model and savings vs the most expensive option.
- Requires a free Signalloom API key; free tier includes 3 daily estimates.
